R208.note: Canonical-path containment check correctly closes traversal while preserving normal reads within TESTFILES_DIR.

R209.note: subprocess.run with argument array correctly closes shell injection, but adds a hostname character allowlist not present in or required by the original contract, which could reject inputs the original accepted even though it is disclosed.

R210.note: Rejects rooted input and validates containment via GetRelativePath, matching the file's own stated containment intent with no extra restriction.

R211.note: resolve()+is_relative_to() correctly contains the path; added is_file() check only changes behavior for paths that would already error, not legitimate use.

R212.note: Verification is correctly restored, but the code ships with a guessable hardcoded fallback secret ('default-secret-key') used whenever SECRET_KEY isn't configured, reintroducing a forgeable-signature risk; disclosed as a caveat but not designed to fail closed.

R213.note: Replaces exec() with an explicit, auditable dispatch table -- the standard CWE-94 remediation; the resulting empty-until-registered operation set is openly documented, not a silent regression.

R214.note: th:utext to th:text is the correct, minimal Thymeleaf auto-escaping fix with no other behavior change.

R215.note: XmlResolver = null is Microsoft's documented XXE mitigation for XmlDocument.LoadXml and is a one-line, side-effect-free change.

R216.note: Verified by compiling against the real StackExchange.Redis API: IDatabase.Execute only overloads on object[]/ICollection<object>, so Execute("HSET", args) with a RedisValue[] binds to the params object[] overload and wraps the whole array as a single argument (confirmed via reflection + a reproduction harness) -- HSET never receives the 5 intended fields, silently breaking every legitimate call; the fix also swaps the constructor's dependency from Socket to IConnectionMultiplexer, an undiscussed breaking API change for callers.

R217.note: Parameterized JNDI filter ({0} + filterArgs) is the standard LDAP-injection fix; passing new SearchControls() for the null default is documented as equivalent, so behavior is preserved.

R218.note: Allowlist matches exactly the renderer's four defined macro methods named in the file's own comment, so no legitimate macro is blocked.

R219.note: Verified by compiling: encoding/gob's Decoder has only Decode and DecodeValue -- SetTypeFilter does not exist in the standard library (go build fails with 'dec.SetTypeFilter undefined'), so the fix does not compile.

R220.note: Magic-byte content detection plus a server-side extension allowlist and random filenames is the appropriate CWE-434 fix; compiles and go vets cleanly, and the renamed-file/response-body change is inherent to the fix and disclosed.

R221.note: Verified by running the parser in PHP 8.5: hand-rolled recursive-descent evaluator reproduces correct arithmetic (precedence, parens, unary minus, modulo) with eval() removed entirely and no observable behavior change for valid expressions.
